boundary_hardening_targets.name: Implicit Globalization Hardening
boundary_hardening_targets.requirement: Prevent any restricted-local proof statement from being recursively reinterpreted as global continuation behavior.

boundary_hardening_targets.name: Composition Leakage Hardening
boundary_hardening_targets.requirement: Prevent local LAW034 composition support from implying unrestricted compositional closure.

boundary_hardening_targets.name: Identity Drift Hardening
boundary_hardening_targets.requirement: Detect and isolate cases where admissible persistence survives while identity reconstruction becomes ambiguous.

boundary_hardening_targets.name: Boundary Expansion Hardening
boundary_hardening_targets.requirement: Prevent admissibility boundary growth beyond declared restricted-local domains.

boundary_hardening_targets.name: Failure Geometry Persistence Hardening
boundary_hardening_targets.requirement: Ensure preserved blockers remain structurally attached after hardening passes.

hardening_failure_classes.name: Recursive Scope Bleed
hardening_failure_classes.meaning: Local proof stability recursively propagates into undeclared domains.

hardening_failure_classes.name: Compositional Closure Leakage
hardening_failure_classes.meaning: Restricted-local composition implicitly reconstructs unresolved global closure.

hardening_failure_classes.name: Persistence-Identity Decoupling
hardening_failure_classes.meaning: Admissibility image persists while identity continuity becomes unrecoverable.

hardening_failure_classes.name: Hidden Boundary Inflation
hardening_failure_classes.meaning: Admissibility domain expands beyond declared D_L constraints.

hardening_failure_classes.name: Failure Geometry Suppression
hardening_failure_classes.meaning: Hardening pass incorrectly removes preserved blockers or excluded domains.
